Implemented generated tool lifecycle visibility in the Agent tab and generated design review. Outcome-created tools now show auto-created, status, implementation kind, and enabled/not enabled state. Verified with npm run web:build.

Proof loop now shows run mode and judge mode near the active action and explains deterministic rubric-only failures as needing live rubric judging. Verified with npm run web:build.

Passing generated lifecycles now show an evidence-backed completion panel with version, tools, run evidence, judge evidence, and trace link when available. Inspect buttons open saved run/eval artifacts. Verified with npm run web:build.
